description: Election Commission - Mr. D. J. Abeysiriwardhana of the Kanburupitiya Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Kamburupitiya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and local government elections matters, specifically fitting Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it involves the status of elected officials in local authorities.
